name: floor-buildup-report
description: v0.31.6.2 — floor build-up + HDB thickness limits in the report. Captures the printable report via the window.open intercept, asserts the section exists, that the WET-ROOM FALL warning leads (Bath/WC 1 sits 8 mm above Main Bedroom on the shipped flat — bedded porcelain against vinyl), and that the doorway-step note is present, then renders the HTML into the page to screenshot the real table.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: wait-report-captured
steps.failMessage: openDesignReport() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-buildup-section
steps.eval:
(function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; const i = html.indexOf('

Floor build-up & levels

'); if (i < 0) throw new Error('report has no Floor build-up section in Pro'); const next = html.indexOf('

', i + 4); const sec = html.slice(i, next < 0 ? html.length : next); if (!/Wet room floor falls OUT toward a dry room/.test(sec)) throw new Error('no wet-room fall warning: ' + sec.slice(0,400)); if (!/sits 8 mm above Main Bedroom/.test(sec)) throw new Error('wet-room fall does not name the measured 8 mm step'); if (sec.indexOf('falls OUT') > sec.indexOf('Room')) throw new Error('warning sits BELOW the reference table — the one error in the section is buried'); if (!/Doorway steps needing a threshold detail/.test(sec)) throw new Error('no doorway-step note'); if (/\+NaN|undefined mm/.test(sec)) throw new Error('unresolved value rendered: ' + sec.slice(0,300)); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-buildup
steps.eval: (function(){ const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Floor build-up & levels'); if (!h) throw new Error('rendered report has no Floor build-up heading'); h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); })()
